Class TurnPosition

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.tiles.TurnPosition
public class TurnPosition extends Object
A single space on the Turn Order Tile. Each space has a fixed position (1 = top) and a food bonus or penalty - 1st space: +3 food - 2nd space: +1 food - middle spaces: no bonus - last space: pay 1 food (or lose 2 PP if no food available) The totem colour identifies which player is occupying the space.
